title: 卡尔萨斯·靛青长阶
description: 卡尔萨斯穿完整深蓝长袍静立高阶，苍白冠面与长杖形成竖向轮廓，没有腐朽或恐怖细节，强侧光带来庄重感。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Karthus is a tall spectral robed figure with a pale skull-like mask face, a high pointed crown, long dark blue-violet garments, and a luminous staff. Preserve the recognizable lich silhouette but simplify the face into clean ivory planes without exposed decay or frightening teeth. All body areas remain covered by opaque layered cloth, and the staff stands grounded beside him with only a steady restrained glow.
art_direction.scene: Place him motionless on broad empty stone stairs, one covered hand holding the grounded staff and the other resting at the chest. A monumental open window admits a hard pale beam that cuts across crown and robe. Deep indigo wax-crayon facets and a distant clear horizon give the complete figure solemn scale, with no graves, victims, fog, or threatening magic.
art_direction.palette: indigo, mask ivory, mist blue, narrow gold light
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
